summary: Comprehensive test suite with good coverage of all major functionality. Unit tests (license-checker.bats) systematically cover manifest detection, parsing, license lookup, classification, report generation, and CLI argument handling. Integration tests (workflow.bats) validate workflow structure, actionlint compliance, and end-to-end behavior through act with exact output matching. Tests properly exercise exit codes (0/1/2/64), error scenarios, and multiple manifest types. Minor weaknesses: some edge cases (invalid JSON, malformed CSV, empty manifests) not explicitly tested; integration tests assume fixture files exist but don't create them; some brittleness in output pattern matching. Strengths include clear organization, good use of fixtures/mocking, proper test independence, and thorough CLI validation. Would reliably catch regressions in core functionality.
